description: This source file defines the LinkAnnotations class, which provides methods to add various types of link and annotation elements to PDF pages using the PDFsharp library. It includes functionality for drawing hyperlinks, rubber stamp annotations, and text annotations, as well as rendering test pages with these elements.

classes.name: LinkAnnotations
classes.description: A class for drawing diverse link annotations and other PDF annotations on pages.

methods.name: RenderSnippet
methods.description: Renders various link and annotation elements on a PDF page.

methods.name: RenderTestPage2
methods.description: Renders a test page with hyperlinks and placeholders for annotations.

methods.name: AddHyperlink
methods.description: Creates and adds a hyperlink annotation of specified type to a PDF page.
